visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a car at night, a young man with short dark hair drives while looking forward. A woman sits in the passenger seat, partially visible. The interior is dark with streetlights reflecting on the windshield. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor living room. A man in a white sleeveless tank top and a woman in a grey graphic t-shirt sit on a beige couch with plush toys behind them. Bright studio-style lighting illuminates the room. The woman gestures with her hands while talking to the man. (3) A series of quick cuts show the couple facing each other and then looking at the camera. They shout words simultaneously while variety-style text overlays appear around them. The man looks confused while the woman laughs and points at him. (4) The woman leans towards the man, holding his hands and explaining something intensely. The background remains the same with soft pillows and a plain wall. (5) The couple finally says the same word together. They both burst into laughter, the woman claps her hands, and pink heart overlays float on the screen as they wave goodbye to the camera.

(3) A loud 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as both speakers shout words simultaneously. The BGM increases in volume with a steady electronic beat.
